end.parentNote: Asha practised animal names and sounds with Krish. Krish corrected the duck–moo mix-up later by saying that a duck says quack and a cow says moo; animal-name recall still needs more practice next time. Krish also shared a concerning statement about not being here, then said their mother was nearby and had been told; please stay close, listen calmly, and seek immediate local support if they may be in danger. At home, use a picture game to ask, “What animal is this?” and “What sound does it make?”
